report.error: Poison-row restart must capture a failed transaction recovery sample: actual unobserved, expected observed

diagnosis.movement: The exact poison mutation receipt allowed the live vehicle to reach restart, and the restarted seed loaded the poison during final SQL attachment.
diagnosis.blockingOperation: SQLQueryEngine.activateDistributedTransactionRecovery synchronously loads the cache before it creates its replay promise. StartupRuntimeHandoffOwner records the typed failure and rethrows it through attachSqlRuntimeToStartupOwner into the non-awaiting seed/join entrypoint, so the process exits before the 250ms readiness poll can observe the typed handoff snapshot.
diagnosis.nextDiscriminator: The shared attachment must normalize an already owner-classified synchronous throw into a handled rejected return, and mark asynchronous rejections handled, while preserving rejection for explicit awaiting callers. BootstrapAPI can then remain fail-closed on a typed 503 readiness snapshot.
